title: WhoIs-on-every-request auth model: no session state, no replay window
description: kithd/src/auth.rs — calling Tailscale LocalAPI WhoIs on every request is the correct design for a tailnet-native daemon. It means no session tokens to leak, no token refresh bugs, and no replay window. A future contributor might suggest caching WhoIs results for performance; that would introduce a window where a revoked node's identity is still accepted. The per-request overhead is bounded by the Unix socket round trip to tailscaled (sub-millisecond on localhost) and is worth the security property.
